g.text: Bank Database ER Diagram (Strict Chen / EER Notation)
Strong and weak entities, composite and derived attributes, min-max constraints, and participation are shown explicitly.

svg.text: Composite attributes are shown for CUSTOMER.name and CUSTOMER.address. Weak-entity behavior appears in LOAN_PAYMENT with partial key payment_no.
Candidate keys are also lightly underlined for readability: ACCOUNT.account_number and BRANCH.branch_code.
